name: bandit.r008_fire_signal_roof_lifecycle_mcw
description: Outcome-sized exposed-roof R-008 laboratory. Setup receipts prove only the generated roof, distributed fuel, source zone, fire tools, and existing camp zones. The worker creates the fire through ordinary player UI, retreats exactly two map tiles with a native movement receipt, then owns a long production observation through whichever signal, approach, camp, bubble, return, and persistence boundaries the run can honestly settle.

input: ordinary fire setup and worker-owned live cockpit

steps.label: load_roof_laboratory
steps.expected_visible_fact: the generated basecamp roof laboratory reaches ordinary gameplay

steps.label: audit_roof_fire_tools
steps.abort_reason: normal player-action brazier or charged lighter setup is missing

steps.label: audit_roof_surface_and_distributed_fuel
steps.abort_reason: generated flat roof or distributed log footing is missing

steps.label: audit_roof_source_zone
steps.abort_reason: roof SOURCE_FIREWOOD does not cover the distributed fuel

steps.label: audit_roof_camp_locker
steps.abort_reason: the inherited production CAMP_LOCKER footing is missing

steps.label: audit_roof_camp_patrol
steps.abort_reason: the inherited production CAMP_PATROL footing is missing

steps.label: audit_roof_has_no_fixture_fire
steps.abort_reason: fixture fire or smoke would contaminate the player-created signal

steps.label: bind_roof_native_world
steps.expected_visible_fact: a current run-bound native world frame precedes worker-owned setup and observation

steps.label: observe_roof_fire_signal_lifecycle
steps.objective: Create a genuine burning brazier through ordinary player UI, move exactly two ordinary map tiles away using a native receipt, then settle as many connected fire-signal, bandit, camp-locker, patrol, shakedown/combat, bubble, return, and persistence claims as this bound production run supports. An initial structural dispatch may be credited to fire only when a production event says so; otherwise distinguish the earlier dispatch cause from later smoke/light detection and approach.
proof_targets: ordinary brazier deployment and charged-lighter ignition with saved or native result evidence
exact two-tile retreat before observation waiting
stable hostile origin and actor identity through dispatch or approach, local behavior, departure, abstract return, and persistence when observed
CAMP_LOCKER and CAMP_PATROL behavior plus shakedown watch versus combat escalation when reached
claim-scoped witness bundle and routed defects without erasing unaffected evidence
authority: game.wait, game.raw_wait, or game.keep_watch with an evidence-derived horizon
invariants: all fixture transforms and player-only roof relocation are zero-credit setup
never teleport or fabricate a hostile actor, signal, target, dispatch, or behavior
a short quiet interval is not a negative result
continue after a feature divergence while remaining claims retain clean causal meaning
capability gaps contain only missing reusable interfaces; gameplay defects return in the witness bundle

evidence_contract.claim: claim-scoped exposed-roof fire-signal and camp lifecycle evidence from production-owned responders
evidence_contract.failure_rule: Setup, a short absence, an unexplained arrival, lost actor identity, unisolated channel, or one feature verdict applied to the whole run cannot settle the family charter.
